messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Acme Design is dropping off a large plaster 'wave' sculpture today at 2:30pm for the lobby install tomorrow. They'll have 2 visitors + one crate. It's fragile. Can we confirm check-in, escort, and a temporary storage spot?
frontdesk-bot: New visitor pre-register: Acme Design — 2 guests, ETA 14:30. Pre-printed badges ready. Check-in code: ACME-WAVE. Reply 'confirm' to accept.
Toni: Thanks — do we hand out contractor badges or visitor lanyards? We don't want them wandering into eng.
Maya: Visitor lanyards with a small 'Contractor' sticker is fine. Please escort to the loading dock. @frontdesk-bot please mark 'escort required'.
frontdesk-bot: Escort scheduled. Badge color: Yellow-visitor. Note added: crate labeled 'Fragile - plaster'.
Rob: I can meet them at the loading dock at 14:25 and help carry the crate to temporary staging by the service elevator.
Ash: FYI I have a delivery at 13:00 that might need the same floor cart — it's Lina's farewell cake (do not open). Can we avoid cart conflicts?
Jules: Cake + sculpture day, exciting. Where do we stash the crate overnight? Not great to leave in the main lobby after hours.
Maya: Temporary staging in Conference B (use foam matting) is OK for tonight. We'll move the piece to final spot tomorrow morning. Rob/Linda please confirm access to Conf B at ~18:00.
Linda: Confirmed — Conf B reserved 14:40-18:30 for staging. I've put a sticky on the door and left the keycode with front desk. Badges will be at the desk; guests should check in with code `ACME-WAVE`. Also: photography permitted but keep away from the exec portraits wall.
Rob: Got it. I'll bring the roll cart, extra blankets, and a dolly for the crate.
Ash: (reacts with :thumbsup:) Also posted a "do not open" note in the deliveries channel for the cake.
Toni: Perfect. I'll print contractor stickers and bring extra adhesive. Anyone available to escort at ~15:00 while Rob unloads?
Jules: I can escort at 15:00 — happy to help.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll add a short note to the ops calendar and ping Facilities. cc: @Lina — cake will be kept safe :)
Linda: Check-in instructions for front desk:
```
1) Ask for code (ACME-WAVE)
2) Print yellow visitor badge
3) Add 'Contractor' sticker
4) Log visitor names in iPad check-in
5) Escort to service elevator -> Conf B
```
Toni: Leaving a spare pair of gloves and bubble wrap in the supplies closet (cabinet 2) in case the crate needs extra padding.
Rob: I'll radio when I'm at the dock, should be there by 14:20.
Maya: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll update this thread if the ETA shifts.
